posts.subject: Looking for improvements for minigames
posts.bodyHtml:
I'm currently looking for bugged minigames or maps that could be improved on minigames, I don't have enough time to test them all today but I will post more maps in this topic tomorrow. ( I will check all the maps 🙂 )


Mg_Adev


-Path in level 2 ( red room ) can sometimes be hardly visible due to bright colours.


Mg_awp_submarine_v4csgo


-No Bugs found
-Map looks bit too dull


Mg_breakbox_dream_v1


-No bugs found
-Players could camp on solid object's ( leads to camping )


mg_cartoon_course_v3_3_ez
Fences that instantly kill you are bit too close (map called ez)
-Lasers that kill you when you have to ladder climb ( the little room after the "Break me door" you have to be very accurate )


mg_colours_hard_course


-Nothing I found
-Map looks rather too plain


mg_crash_bandicoot_course


-Later in the map there is a flickering ground and if you fall you die


mg_cyber_course_v3


-If you use your flashlight on stage (6) you can see the invisible blocks
-stage (10) you need to have accurate jumps as the blocks flicker

Zitat von OxygeN

Mg_Adev
-Path in level 2 ( red room ) can sometimes be hardly visible due to bright colours.

Not a bug and they are perfectly visible for me.

Zitat von OxygeN

Mg_awp_submarine_v4csgo


-No Bugs found
-Map looks bit too dull

No bugs found, why report it then? AWP_submarine is a classic and simple map, which is really popular, no need to change things.

Zitat von OxygeN

Mg_breakbox_dream_v1


-No bugs found
-Players could camp on solid object's ( leads to camping )

No need to report it, since there were no bugs

Zitat von OxygeN

mg_cartoon_course_v3_3_ez
Fences that instantly kill you are bit too close (map called ez)
-Lasers that kill you when you have to ladder climb ( the little room after the "Break me door" you have to be very accurate )

Thats the easier version of the cartoon course map. But also, there are no bugs here as well. You dying isn't a bug.

Zitat von OxygeN

mg_colours_hard_course


-Nothing I found
-Map looks rather too plain

No bugs either, only opinion.

Zitat von OxygeN

mg_crash_bandicoot_course


-Later in the map there is a flickering ground and if you fall you die

Thats not a bug but rather how the map is designed.

Zitat von OxygeN

mg_cyber_course_v3


-If you use your flashlight on stage (6) you can see the invisible blocks
-stage (10) you need to have accurate jumps as the blocks flicker

Although using the flashlight on Stage 6 is a "bug", it's pretty helpful for new players and there is no harm done in using it, since it's a course map.
Stage 10 is not a bug.


Total: --> nothing to fix <--
I'm gonna look for more tomorrow ( Don't judge people started to connect )
